name: esp_video_capture_service_apply_setup
description: Configure video capture streams, optional audio tracks, overlay, and muxer settings before start

fixed_src_sample_rate.description: Optional source audio sample-rate pin in Hz; 0 leaves unset

fb_num.description: V4L2 frame buffer count; 0 uses Kconfig default

share_overlay.description: Share one overlay mixer across sinks

full_speed_decode.description: Decode before re-encode on the source path

streams.description: One or two output stream configurations

audio_codec.description: Optional audio FourCC such as 'AAC '; omit or empty for no audio track

video_codec.description: Optional video FourCC such as 'H264' or 'MJPG'

name: esp_video_capture_service_enable_stream
description: Enable or disable one output stream

name: esp_video_capture_service_start_record
description: Start recording on a stream with a preconfigured storage muxer

name: esp_video_capture_service_set_storage_url
description: Set or clear the manual storage URL for a stream

name: esp_video_capture_service_get_last_storage_url
description: Get the most recently generated recording URL for a stream

name: esp_video_capture_service_get_storage_file_info
description: Stat a recorded storage file and return size, mtime, and ctime. Omit url to use the stream last storage URL.

stream.description: Stream ID used when resolving the last storage URL; defaults to 0

url.description: Absolute file path to query; omit to use last storage URL

name: esp_video_capture_service_overlay_enable_redraw
description: Enable or disable periodic overlay redraw

name: esp_video_capture_service_get_status
description: Get the video capture service state and name
